mapper.insert: INSERT INTO show_review_report (review_id, reporter_id, reason, status, handler_id, handled_at, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{reviewId}, #{reporterId}, #{reason}, #{status}, #{handlerId}, #{handledAt}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT id, review_id, reporter_id, reason, status, handler_id, handled_at, create_time, update_time FROM show_review_report WHERE id = #{id}

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM show_review_report
AND status = #{status}
